business_objective: Reserve, issue, acknowledge, and close requests for standard consumable kits held in internal stock.

stakeholder_statements.text: A department requester submits a request for a standard consumable kit and identifies the receiving team.
The stock clerk checks whether the requested kit is available and records the reserved quantity.
The inventory custodian picks the reserved kits and marks them ready for collection.
The department receiver records the quantity collected and acknowledges receipt.
The inventory lead closes the request only after receipt is acknowledged. Custom kit assembly and purchasing are outside this project.

business_objective: Moderate product reviews, support shopper revisions, and publish cleared reviews with permitted merchant responses.

stakeholder_statements.text: A shopper submits a product review with a rating and comment for an item they purchased.
The moderation specialist checks the review for restricted content and records it as cleared or returned with a reason. The restricted-content categories are not finalized.
A shopper may edit and resubmit a returned review while the product listing is active.
After a review is cleared, the merchant representative may submit one public response.
The publication coordinator publishes the cleared review and any permitted merchant response. Resolving delivery disputes and changing product ratings are outside this project.

business_objective: Review supplier onboarding packages, assess risk, approve service-category qualification, and activate accepted supplier records.

stakeholder_statements.text: A supplier representative submits an onboarding package and identifies the service category they want to provide.
The vendor intake officer checks whether the required documents are present and returns an incomplete package. The required-document list has not been agreed.
The risk assessor records a risk classification and any mitigation required for the supplier. The risk categories are not finalized.
After the risk assessment, the category owner approves the supplier for the identified category or returns the package for additional information.
The vendor records clerk marks an approved supplier active and records the effective date. Contract negotiation and purchase-order creation are outside this project.

business_objective: Review driver qualification renewals and prevent new trip assignments when qualifications are rejected or expired.

stakeholder_statements.text: An assigned driver submits a qualification renewal request with current credential evidence before the existing qualification ends. We have not decided how early a request may be submitted.
The credential clerk checks whether the required evidence is present and records the request as complete or incomplete. The required evidence set is not agreed.
The safety reviewer records the renewal as accepted or rejected and adds a reason when it is rejected.
When the renewal is accepted, the credential clerk records the new qualification validity end date.

The fleet scheduler may assign a driver to a future trip only while the qualification is active. Rejected or expired qualifications remain in history, and training delivery and licensing-authority submissions are outside this project.

business_objective: Register, verify, restrict, and revoke patient-authorized proxy access while preserving an unresolved conflict about access to care-plan summaries.

stakeholder_statements.text: A patient nominates a care proxy, identifies the proxy, and selects the care areas covered by the authorization.
The authorization clerk verifies the patient request and the proxy's identity before activating it. The acceptable verification evidence has not been agreed.
The care coordinator says an active proxy should be able to view appointment details and care-plan summaries. The coordinator records when access is provided.
The privacy reviewer says proxies may view appointment details but must never see care-plan summaries. The reviewer records any access restriction.

The patient may revoke an active authorization, and the authorization clerk records the revocation before further proxy access is allowed. Nobody has decided whether authorizations expire automatically or who resolves disputed restrictions. The team also debated whether the waiting room needs new artwork.
